awards.heading: Admissions Team Job Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC admissions-team duties, paid after duties each semester. This work-contingent program needs record-type policy confirmation.

awards.heading: American Ford Scholarship
awards.conditions: College selects greatest needs with donor approval each year; individual scholarship allocation and applicant criteria are not established.

awards.heading: Angel Grant Law Enforcement Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC second-semester freshman majoring in law enforcement and returning in fall. Law Enforcement Club participation is a preference. Selection emphasizes academics, recommendations and professional potential rather than need.

awards.heading: August " Cole" Dooper Memorial Endowed Baseball Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC freshman or sophomore baseball player; coaching staff selects recipient.

awards.heading: Ardean A.Anvik Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time DCC student in good standing; interest in creative writing, political/civic discourse or social-science issues; overall GPA3.0.

awards.heading: Astoria Hotel & Suites Athletic Scholarship
awards.conditions: Returning DCC athlete nominated by coaches for character, leadership and community service; not an incoming-student award.

awards.heading: Bryan Melle Law Enforcement Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC second-semester freshman in law enforcement; returning sophomore preference.

awards.heading: Buzz Suhr Memorial
awards.conditions: Carl H. Suhr Junior Memorial Fund: vocational tuition support with preference for agri-mechanics or a related mechanical program; foundation committee sets selection standards.

awards.heading: Charles England Memorial Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Dawson County High School graduate; full-time DCC student, GPA2.5. Financial need is a consideration, not decisive. Whitefish graduation does not meet the named-school requirement.

awards.heading: Charles Kintz Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC business major selected by financial-aid committee.

awards.heading: Classes 56-58 & 77-78 of Dawson County High School
awards.conditions: Dawson County High School graduates; nontraditional students preferred; possible second-semester renewal with GPA3.0.

awards.heading: Clayton E. Hoyt Endowed Scholarship
awards.amount: Tuition and fees; other support may vary
awards.conditions: DCC student in good standing with overall GPA2.0; tuition and fees supported. Additional books, supplies, equipment or campus housing may be supported with demonstrated need.

awards.heading: Community First Foundation Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC baseball and softball support; stated approximately$450 annual funding is explicitly based on2006 interest rates, so no current amount is proposed.

awards.heading: Culver Insurance and Blue Cross Blue Shield Endowment Scholarship
awards.conditions: Business study is preferred; committee may select another student if no business applicants. One-year award.

awards.heading: Dawson Promise Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Dawson Promise supports students who are homeless or aging out of foster care in obtaining a debt-free two-year education. Exact total award and program-specific intake conditions are not given here.

awards.heading: DCC Plates Endowment
awards.conditions: General endowment may fund or supplement multiple scholarships, with no restricted educational/sports program. Not a separately identified applicant award.

awards.heading: Dennis Perryman Men’s Basketball Endowment
awards.conditions: Proceeds benefit the DCC men’s basketball program; no distinct individual scholarship or applicant selection method stated.

awards.heading: Don Kettner Presidential Endowment
awards.conditions: Heading describes incoming-freshman/need endowment, then body describes a separate Kettner education scholarship with$250 and March15 terms. Distinct fund identities and applicable rules are ambiguous; do not merge or inherit one set.

awards.heading: Duane Peterson Law Enforcement Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC second-semester freshman majoring in law enforcement and returning in fall; academics, recommendations and potential rather than need.

awards.heading: Ellis and Irene Jones Endowed Scholarship
awards.amount: Equivalent of in-district tuition and fees
awards.conditions: Full-time DCC student in good standing, GPA2.5; eastern Montana is a preference. Financial need is considered, not decisive; limited housing/books support for high-achieving impoverished students. One-year award; reapply for another year.

awards.heading: Evelyn Schaffel Education Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time DCC student pursuing AA/AS teacher-education emphasis and later education bachelor’s degree; ED100 and another approved ED course already completed. Satisfactory academic progress needed for second payment; separate typed application packet.

awards.heading: F.J. Efta Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Wibaux County High School senior/graduate OR young adult with a special Wibaux County connection, planning DCC. Full-time enrollment and GPA2.0 in12credits for continuation; up to four consecutive semesters. A qualifying county connection is a condition, not inferred from Whitefish attendance.

awards.heading: Floyd and Francis Marty Music Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Music major; piano/voice preferred; financial-aid committee selects. Page also names Francis Marty Music Scholarship as the fund title.

awards.heading: Fran M. Albrecht Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time first- or second-year DCC student demonstrating financial need. Acute-need prioritization is not established.

awards.heading: Frank Sir Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Page contains donor biography without applicant eligibility or award-specific selection criteria. Do not convert the donor’s biography to applicant requirements.

awards.heading: Gary L. Olson Memorial Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time DCC student in good standing, law enforcement or related field, satisfactory academics. Need considered but not decisive; one-year award with reapplication for another year.

awards.heading: Gary Nelson Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Only establishment history given; no applicant criteria.

awards.heading: George and Ottoni Rice Law Enforcement Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC second-semester freshman majoring in law enforcement and returning in fall. Selection emphasizes academics, references and professional potential rather than need.

awards.heading: Glendive Coca-Cola Bottling Company Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Admitted or enrolled DCC student in good standing. Full-time attendance and study in physical education, sports management, medicine, dietetics, wellness or related fields are preferences. One-year award; need considered but not decisive.

awards.heading: Glendive Masonic Lodge
awards.conditions: Entering full-time DCC student meeting general scholarship criteria; no specific major required. No Masonic membership requirement stated.

awards.heading: Gregory & Peggy Johnson STEM Endowment
awards.conditions: Donor biography and endowment history only; no stated applicant criteria. Do not infer eligibility from STEM in the heading or donor careers.

awards.heading: Hayden and Madisyn Moore Scholarship
awards.conditions: Student-athletes from Colorado or Wyoming planning DCC; men’s basketball preferred. The only stated$500 amount is dated2021–22.

awards.heading: Hildebrand Hood Pressman Scholarship
awards.conditions: Donor biography only, no applicant criteria; medical/dental profession of donor is not an applicant requirement.

awards.heading: Howard C. Hodous Memorial Law Enforcement Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Law-enforcement student at DCC. Full tuition is a future donor goal, not a verified current award amount.

awards.heading: Hystad Family Endowment for Academic Scholarships
awards.conditions: Students from eastern Montana or Slope/Golden Valley counties North Dakota; excludes current Whitefish location. Page conflicts GPA2.2 with continuation2.5 and has additional nonathletic/conduct rules; do not resolve these by assumption.

awards.heading: James D. Schultz Memorial Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Admitted/enrolled DCC student in good standing preparing to transfer to a secondary-education bachelor’s degree, English teaching major or related field; satisfactory academics. One-year award with reapplication.

awards.heading: James P. Vomhof Presidential Fund
awards.conditions: DCC business student with financial need; no acute-need priority established.

awards.heading: Jeanie Austin Nelson Memorial Rodeo Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC second-semester freshman, rodeo athlete with college rodeo points, under24, cumulative GPA2.5, full-time and returning in fall. Separate application before April8, year unspecified; academic/athletic achievement, recommendations and partial need considered.

awards.heading: Joe Friederichs Memorial Science Scholarship
awards.conditions: First/second-year student entering or returning to DCC, majoring in a field requiring chemistry, such as engineering, allied health, science or science education.

awards.heading: Jonas Kolberg Memorial Agriculture Scholarship
awards.conditions: DCC freshman majoring in agriculture and returning in fall; academic achievement, recommendations and potential rather than need.

awards.heading: JSEC Outside Scholarship
awards.conditions: Graduating seniors from Circle,Glendive,Richey orWibaux schools, or returning DCC students from those areas. Whitefish does not meet named origin condition.

awards.heading: Kay Dunkerley-Magnussen Memorial Art Scholarship
awards.conditions: Graduating Dawson County High School senior attending DCC; DCHS teachers/administrator select.

awards.heading: Keith P. Guelff Memorial Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time DCC student in good standing, agribusiness or related field, GPA2.75. Need considered, not decisive. One-year award with reapplication.

awards.heading: Kenneth Skillestad Memorial Scholarship Fund
awards.conditions: Dawson County High School graduate attending DCC; DCHS counselors/administrator select.

awards.heading: M.C. and Florence Kolstad Vocational Technical Scholarship
awards.conditions: Skill-based vocational program at DCC; original auto-mechanics program discontinued. Academic achievement and recommendations rather than need.

awards.heading: Martha Kelly Memorial Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time DCC education major with permanent residence within100miles of Glendive. Whitefish permanent residence does not meet this rule.

awards.heading: Mary Moore Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Dawson County High School senior planning DCC education major; named-school requirement excludes Whitefish graduates.

awards.heading: Music Faculty Salary Endowment
awards.conditions: Funds a college faculty salary, not a student scholarship.

awards.heading: Patricia A. (Trish) Matteson Endowed Educational Scholarship
awards.conditions: Education career purpose stated, but page explicitly directs readers to foundation for applicant criteria. No provider contact authorized; exact conditions remain unknown.

awards.heading: Raymond and Natha Ostby Foundation Scholarships
awards.conditions: DCC freshmen returning to DCC, academic excellence, desire to address a societal need and intent to transfer to a four-year institution. Two recipient scholarships are not separately named awards.

awards.heading: Ree Ride Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time DCC first/second-year agriculture student or rodeo athlete with no access to other funds. Page makes availability conditional on fund growth and future application process; current individual application route/funding unresolved.

awards.heading: Reid Ripley Memorial Agriculture Scholarship
awards.conditions: First/second-year agriculture student entering/returning DCC; Dawson/surrounding area preferred. Academic achievement, recommendations and potential rather than need.

awards.heading: Richard E. Guenzi Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: First/second-year DCC student planning computer-science major; named institutional selection committee.

awards.heading: Richard and Winifred McMullin Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Full-time first/second-year DCC science major, with biology,botany,earth science ormedicine preferred. Award unavailable until endowment reaches$5000; current threshold/application availability unverified.

awards.heading: Roger Carl Smith Memorial Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Disbursement requires annual earnings threshold; biography and administration terms do not identify applicant criteria.

awards.heading: Roman S. Zuroff Endowed Scholarship Fund
awards.conditions: Full-time DCC student in good standing majoring in pre-health fields such as medical science/nursing,medicine,dental oroptometry; satisfactory academics; financial need considered.

awards.heading: Ron Conrad Drama Endowment Scholarship
awards.conditions: Fine arts study preferred. If no fine-arts applicants, preference for applicants without athletic scholarships. Financial need considered, not decisive; one-year award.

awards.heading: Rotary Club of Glendive Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Dawson County high-school or home-school graduate, full-time DCC, GPA2.5 and community-service record. Whitefish does not meet county-graduation requirement.

awards.heading: Stockman Bank Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: Montana resident admitted/enrolled at DCC in good standing; agriculture-related study and full-time status preferred. Need considered, not decisive. One-year award with reapplication.

awards.heading: Vietnam Veterans of America Scholarship Glendive Chapter \#134
awards.conditions: US citizen/Montana resident with specified veteran or military-family relationship and GPA2.0; headingChapter134 conflicts bodyChapter234. Separate chapter application and identity unresolved; do not invent destination.

awards.heading: W. and Ann Dohrmann Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Page restricts to area students without defining area. Full-time DCC,2.0GPA in12credits for continuedpayments, up to4semesters. Whitefish audience cannot be established from ambiguous area rule.

awards.heading: Wendee Eyer Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Recent Dawson County High School graduate attending DCC, GPA3.0 and high-school math/science emphasis.

awards.heading: Westley J. Toepke Memorial Endowed Scholarship
awards.conditions: First-time full-time DCC student with permanent residence within100miles of Glendive. Whitefish does not meet geographic requirement.

awards.heading: Zach Anderson Memorial Scholarship
awards.conditions: Graduated from listed eastern-Montana AAU counties orWilliamsCountyND; graduating seniors through collegejuniors, athletes. Whitefish/FlatheadCounty absent from eligibleorigin list.

formReconciliation.commonRequirements: The linked general form requires admission application and high-school cumulative GPA2.25 for first-year students; transfer applicants need12graded college credits and cumulative college GPA2.25. Current/former DCC students need degree-seeking admission, degree/certificate enrollment or plans,12graded credits and GPA2.0; dual-enrollment students need12credits to use the returning category. Resume, academic-goals essay, transcripts, two recommendations and award-specific materials are required. DCC requires FAFSA for need-based awards. These general conditions do not replace higher or narrower award-specific conditions.

materialConflictHolds.Reid Ripley Memorial Agriculture Scholar: Foundation says Dawson/surrounding area is a preference; current linked form requires Dawson County or surrounding-area residence. Material Whitefish audience conflict unresolved.
materialConflictHolds.Ellis and Irene Jones Endowed Scholarshi: Foundation says eastern Montana preference; current linked form says located in Eastern Montana. Material Whitefish audience conflict unresolved.
materialConflictHolds.Evelyn Schaffel Education Scholarship: Foundation requires ED100 plus an additional approved ED course; current form requires EDU200 or an approved EDU course. Exact prerequisite and returning-student criteria differ; hold material audience/coursework conflict.
materialConflictHolds.Angel Grant Law Enforcement Memorial Sch: Foundation requires second-semester freshman returning in fall; current form treats returning sophomore as preference. Exact entering/returning eligibility remains contradictory.
materialConflictHolds.Bryan Melle Law Enforcement Memorial Sch: Foundation requires second-semester freshman; form says returning sophomore preferred. Foundation minimum$250 conflicts form up to$250; amount may be omitted, but audience conflict remains.
materialConflictHolds.Duane Peterson Law Enforcement Memorial: Foundation requires second-semester freshman returning in fall; form says returning sophomore preferred. Exact audience condition unresolved.
materialConflictHolds.George and Ottoni Rice Law Enforcement M: Foundation requires second-semester freshman returning in fall; form says returning sophomore preferred. Exact audience condition unresolved.

currentFormNarrowing.Buzz Suhr Memorial: The linked application now specifies Welding Technology and up to$150. The foundation’s older vocational/agri-mechanics description is broader; use the form’s specific welding pathway, without claiming other trades qualify.
currentFormNarrowing.M.C. and Florence Kolstad Vocational Tec: The linked form specifies Gas and Diesel Technology or Welding Technology, with returning sophomores preferred. These specific programs narrow the foundation’s generic skill-based description.
currentFormNarrowing.Charles Kintz Memorial Scholarship: The linked form specifically requires Business Management, prefers returning sophomores and may request an interview. This narrows the foundation’s general business description. Amount differs in format, so no fixed semester amount is proposed.
currentFormNarrowing.Floyd and Francis Marty Music Memorial S: The linked application requires two recorded voice/instrument performance selections or an audition with the DCC music director.
currentFormNarrowing.Richard E. Guenzi Memorial Scholarship: The linked form additionally allows Engineering Technology alongside Computer Science, and lists a variable minimum$250. The foundation names computer science only; the proposed path is restricted to computer science until broader eligibility is reconciled.
currentFormNarrowing.Roman S. Zuroff Endowed Scholarship Fund: The linked form requires demonstrated financial need, beyond the foundation’s statement that need is considered; FAFSA is required for the need-based application.
currentFormNarrowing.Jonas Kolberg Memorial Agriculture Schol: The form specifies Agribusiness and returning-sophomore preference, whereas foundation describes a freshman returning in fall. Preserve the stricter returning agribusiness pathway; exact broader entry-year eligibility remains unverified.
currentFormNarrowing.Gary L. Olson Memorial Endowed Scholarsh: Current named form specifically requires Law Enforcement; broader related fields from foundation remain unresolved.
